title: Handley Page Halifax HX181
memorial_details: A metal plaque held within a wood cross frame and mounted on a small post. The 10 Squadron badge is at the top with the inscription and names below in white, a gold Royal Air Force eagle is at the bottom. A memorial tablet is in place adjacent to the crash site near to the old Royal Air Force Tangmere control tower.
inscription: Plaque: (10 Squadron crest)/ TO COMMEMORATE THE SACRIFICE/ MADE BY THE CREW OF A HALIFAX/ BOMBER, HX 181 (ZA-K) OF/ 10 SQUADRON, RAF MELBOURNE,/ YORKS,/ WHICH CRASHED INTO A HANGAR/ AT RAF TANGMERE ON THE NIGHT/ OF 19 NOVEMBER 1943 AFTER/ SUFFERING SEVERE DAMAGE/ DURING A RAID OVER GERMANY./ ALL THE CREW WERE KILLED./ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM./ (Names)/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA/ (RAF Eagle badge)
